title: Completion treats a lost acceptance-binding obligation row as no obligation
outcome: Completion treats a lost acceptance-binding obligation row as no obligation
acceptance: A test deletes the projection row of a bound criterion's newest obligation and shows completion refusing as a damaged store rather than sealing on, or skipping to, an older obligation

Completion's obligation load refuses with InvalidWorkProjection when a work_obligation or work_obligation_resolution recorded on the run feed has no work_run_obligations projection row, including acceptance-binding obligations triggered by work events

completion.summary: Landed in 088fe7d: completion's cut reader, acceptance-binding selection and the binding read load the run's obligations through a checked load that refuses a feed-recorded obligation definition or resolution without its projection row as a damaged store; readers stay readable and doctor names the damage.
